title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in WPTasty AWP…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in WPTasty AWP Classifieds plugin versions up to 4.4.10. This flaw involves improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags, allowing code injection. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 5.3, indicating medium severity. No public exploits or patches are currently documented.
